intended_object: A specific Scott neighbourhood system on Δ = ℕ with neighbourhoods 𝒟 = {ℕ, {0,1}} ∪ {{n} | n ∈ ℕ}: the flat domain with one extra "stem" element. It is the second example for Exercise 1.15 of Scott's PRG-19 (an infinite domain whose elements are all finite and which has no infinite strictly ascending chain). This comes from the docstring and the module documentation.
